difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally Noetherian X with no embedded points, the sheaf K_X is both the direct sum and the product over the generic points of the pushforwards of the local rings, K_X is a quasi-coherent sheaf of algebras, for every quasi-coherent F the sheaf K_X(F) of meromorphic sections is quasi-coherent, and the ring of rational functions equals the ring of global meromorphic functions (source lines 6314-6338). The proof records that the lemma is the special case of the general weakly-associated statement, because on a locally Noetherian scheme weakly associated points and associated points coincide - and the reason is given explicitly through the cited comparison lemma.
